style_note: Bai insight/loi khuyen truc tiep kieu 'hay/dung', KHONG phai van xuoi van hoc an du. Xem 3 vi du mau da duyet: tuong phan nhan thuc (nguoi moi vs bac thay) + ket bai bang cap reframe 'dung hoi X - hay hoi Y'.
avoid: generic filler like 'moi thu deu co ly do cua no'
empty motivation with no real contrast behind it
long literary description that delays the point
emoji_policy: 0-2 emoji toi da, chi o dau dong hanh dong neu can, khong bat buoc, mac dinh khong dung
